<title>小児科 急患電話マップ</title>
<meta name="claude:viewport-fit-sides" content="cover">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Mochiy+Pop+One&family=Zen+Maru+Gothic:wght@400;500;700&display=swap">
<style>
/* Layout: ロゴ → 電話相談（だれが出る？・メモ）→ 休日・夜間の急患診療所 → 健診・予防接種・医療費（タップで説明）→ 小児科さがし（2列カード）→ 公式ページ → メモ */

/* Layout: ロゴ → 区の地図＋施設数 → 預け先のジャンル（タップで説明）→ さがす（2列カード・タップでふわっとプレビュー）→ 系列・ほかのサービス */
:root{
  --bg:#F3FAFF; --card:#FFFFFF; --ink:#2E2B4F; --muted:#6B6890; --line:#E2E6F3; --soft:#EEF3FC;
  --pink:#FF6FA5; --orange:#FF9A3D; --yellow:#FFCF33; --green:#2ECC85; --blue:#3DB2F2; --purple:#9C7BFF; --mint:#22C3B5;
  --lic:#2ECC85; --gai:#3DB2F2; --glass:rgba(255,255,255,.74); --glass-line:rgba(255,255,255,.9);
  --w-nishi:#FFB3A3; --w-kita:#FFD47A; --w-omiya:#FF9DC2; --w-minuma:#9DDBA6; --w-chuo:#BBA8F6;
  --w-sakura:#FFC0DD; --w-urawa:#8CCBF3; --w-minami:#FFCB96; --w-midori:#88D9BF; --w-iwatsuki:#CBE38A;
  --map-stroke:#FFFFFF; --cloud:#FFFFFF;
  --font-display:"Mochiy Pop One","Zen Maru Gothic","Hiragino Maru Gothic ProN",sans-serif;
  --font-body:"Zen Maru Gothic","Hiragino Maru Gothic ProN","Yu Gothic",system-ui,sans-serif;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){
  --bg:#1B1C33; --card:#26274A; --ink:#F4F2FF; --muted:#B5B3D6; --line:#3A3B62; --soft:#2E2F55;
  --pink:#FF86B4; --orange:#FFAA5A; --yellow:#FFD84F; --green:#4FDC9C; --blue:#5EC1F5; --purple:#B39BFF; --mint:#3DD3C5;
  --lic:#4FDC9C; --gai:#5EC1F5; --glass:rgba(38,39,74,.78); --glass-line:rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  --w-nishi:#C9786A; --w-kita:#C9A24A; --w-omiya:#C66A8F; --w-minuma:#5FA56B; --w-chuo:#8673C9;
  --w-sakura:#C9809F; --w-urawa:#5891BB; --w-minami:#C9915E; --w-midori:#4FA48A; --w-iwatsuki:#93AA52;
  --map-stroke:#1B1C33; --cloud:#3A3B62; color-scheme:dark}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  --bg:#1B1C33; --card:#26274A; --ink:#F4F2FF; --muted:#B5B3D6; --line:#3A3B62; --soft:#2E2F55;
  --pink:#FF86B4; --orange:#FFAA5A; --yellow:#FFD84F; --green:#4FDC9C; --blue:#5EC1F5; --purple:#B39BFF; --mint:#3DD3C5;
  --lic:#4FDC9C; --gai:#5EC1F5; --glass:rgba(38,39,74,.78); --glass-line:rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  --w-nishi:#C9786A; --w-kita:#C9A24A; --w-omiya:#C66A8F; --w-minuma:#5FA56B; --w-chuo:#8673C9;
  --w-sakura:#C9809F; --w-urawa:#5891BB; --w-minami:#C9915E; --w-midori:#4FA48A; --w-iwatsuki:#93AA52;
  --map-stroke:#1B1C33; --cloud:#3A3B62; color-scheme:dark}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:15px;line-height:1.75;margin:0;
  padding-left:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));
  background-image:radial-gradient(circle at 8% 6%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--yellow) 30%,transparent) 0 70px,transparent 71px),
   radial-gradient(circle at 94% 3%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--pink) 22%,transparent) 0 90px,transparent 91px),
   radial-gradient(circle at 70% 14%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue) 18%,transparent) 0 30px,transparent 31px);background-repeat:no-repeat}
.wrap{max-width:1040px;margin:0 auto;word-break:auto-phrase;line-break:strict}
h1,h2,h3,h4{text-wrap:balance;margin:0}
button,input,select{font:inherit;color:inherit}
a{color:var(--blue)}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:8px}
.num{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.nb{display:inline-block}
svg.cute{display:block}
.ci{width:24px;height:24px;flex:0 0 auto;display:block}

/* ---------- logo ---------- */
header{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding-top:26px}
.hero{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;gap:8px;width:100%;max-width:760px}
.monkey{width:clamp(88px,17vw,140px);flex:0 0 auto;transform-origin:50% 4%;animation:swing 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;margin-top:clamp(34px,7vw,60px)}
.monkey img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
@keyframes swing{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-6deg)}50%{transform:rotate(6deg)}}
.logo{position:relative;flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;max-width:560px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center}
.ribbon{position:relative;z-index:2;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#9C7BFF,#FF6FA5 55%,#FF9A3D);color:#fff;font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:clamp(16px,3.4vw,24px);padding:4px 30px 6px;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 4px 0 rgba(46,43,79,.12);margin-bottom:-16px;letter-spacing:.04em}
.cloud{position:relative;width:100%;background:#FFFFFF;border-radius:70px 70px 56px 56px;padding:28px 18px 14px;box-shadow:0 6px 0 rgba(46,43,79,.08)}
.cloud::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:8px;border:3px dashed #A8DCF7;border-radius:62px 62px 48px 48px;pointer-events:none}
.big{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:400;line-height:1.08;margin:0}
.big .row{display:block}.big .r1{font-size:clamp(34px,7.6vw,64px)}.big .r2{font-size:clamp(38px,8.6vw,74px)}
.big i{font-style:normal;display:inline-block;color:var(--cc);text-shadow:3px 3px 0 #fff,-3px 3px 0 #fff,3px -3px 0 #fff,-3px -3px 0 #fff,0 4px 0 #fff,0 -4px 0 #fff,4px 0 0 #fff,-4px 0 0 #fff,0 7px 0 rgba(46,43,79,.14);
  animation:hop .9s cubic-bezier(.3,1.6,.5,1) both;animation-delay:calc(var(--d) * 60ms)}
@keyframes hop{from{transform:translateY(-14px) scale(.85)}to{transform:none}}
.items{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:10px;margin:4px 0 6px}
.items svg{width:100%;height:100%}
.items span{width:44px;height:44px;display:block;animation:bob 2.8s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:calc(var(--d) * .25s)}
@keyframes bob{50%{transform:translateY(-5px) rotate(-4deg)}}
.sub{font-weight:700;color:#3A2E5C;font-size:clamp(15px,3.2vw,20px);line-height:1.45;margin:0}
.pillbox{margin-top:-4px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#BFF0E8,#C9E8FF 50%,#E3D9FF);color:#2B3A7A;font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(13px,2.8vw,16px);line-height:1.5;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 26px;border:3px solid #FFFFFF;box-shadow:0 4px 0 rgba(46,43,79,.08);position:relative;z-index:1}

/* ---------- sections ---------- */
section{margin-top:34px}
.sec-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;margin-bottom:14px}
.sec-head .ico{width:50px;height:50px;flex:0 0 auto}
.sec-head .h{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0}
.sec-head h2{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(22px,3.4vw,28px)}
.sec-head p{margin:2px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}

/* ---------- map ---------- */
.mapcard{background:var(--card);border-radius:30px;padding:10px 14px 14px;box-shadow:0 6px 0 rgba(46,43,79,.06);border:3px solid var(--line)}
.mapbox{max-width:540px;margin:0 auto}
.mapbox svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;overflow:visible}
.ward{cursor:pointer;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center;animation:pop .7s cubic-bezier(.3,1.6,.5,1) both;transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.3,1.6,.5,1)}
.ward path{stroke:var(--map-stroke);stroke-width:4;stroke-linejoin:round;transition:opacity .2s}
.ward:hover{transform:translateY(-5px)}
.ward.on{transform:translateY(-8px) scale(1.03)}
.ward.on path{stroke:var(--ink);stroke-width:4}
.ward.dim path{opacity:.35}
.wlabel{pointer-events:none}
.wlabel rect{fill:var(--card);stroke:var(--ink);stroke-width:2}
.wlabel text{fill:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font-body);font-weight:700;font-size:15px;text-anchor:middle}
.wlabel .cnt{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:13px;fill:var(--pink)}
.sunrays{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center;animation:spin 18s linear infinite}
.mcloud{fill:var(--cloud);animation:drift 14s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.mcloud.c2{animation-duration:19s;animation-delay:-6s}
.hopy{animation:hopy 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes pop{0%{transform:scale(.72)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes drift{from{transform:translateX(-18px)}to{transform:translateX(22px)}}
@keyframes hopy{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-8px)}}
.maphint{text-align:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin:2px 0 8px;font-weight:700}
.totals{display:flex;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.total{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:var(--soft);border-radius:999px;padding:4px 14px 4px 6px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.total .ci{width:28px;height:28px}
.total b{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:400;font-size:20px;line-height:1.2;color:var(--ink)}
.total.l b{color:var(--lic)}.total.g b{color:var(--gai)}

/* ---------- kinds ---------- */
.kgroup{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;margin-bottom:10px}
.kgroup .pill{margin-top:7px}
.kchips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.kchip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;border:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--cc) 30%,var(--line));background:var(--card);border-radius:999px;padding:3px 14px 3px 5px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;
  transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.3,1.6,.5,1),box-shadow .3s,background .3s,border-color .3s}
.kchip .ci{width:30px;height:30px}
.kchip:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.kchip.on{transform:translateY(-6px) scale(1.06);border-color:var(--cc);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--cc) 14%,var(--card));box-shadow:0 8px 16px color-mix(in srgb,var(--cc) 30%,transparent)}
.kchip.on .ci{animation:wig .6s ease-in-out}
@keyframes wig{30%{transform:rotate(-12deg) scale(1.15)}60%{transform:rotate(10deg)}}
.kdet{margin-top:6px;background:var(--card);border:3px solid var(--cc);border-radius:24px;padding:14px 16px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:72px minmax(0,1fr);gap:4px 14px;align-items:center;
  box-shadow:0 10px 24px color-mix(in srgb,var(--cc) 18%,transparent);animation:rise .45s cubic-bezier(.3,1.4,.5,1) both;position:relative}
.kdet::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-12px;left:var(--ax,40px);width:18px;height:18px;background:var(--card);border-left:3px solid var(--cc);border-top:3px solid var(--cc);transform:rotate(45deg);border-radius:4px 0 0 0}
@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px) scale(.97)}}
.kdet .bigi{width:72px;height:72px;grid-row:span 3;animation:bob 2.8s ease-in-out infinite}
.kdet h3{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:400;font-size:21px;color:var(--cc)}
.kdet .meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.kdet .meta span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;background:var(--soft);border-radius:999px;padding:1px 10px 1px 3px}
.kdet .meta .ci{width:22px;height:22px}
.kdet .meta b{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:400;font-size:16px;color:var(--cc)}
.kdet p{margin:0;font-size:14px}
.kdet .go{grid-column:1/-1;justify-self:end;border:0;cursor:pointer;background:var(--cc);color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 16px;margin-top:4px;transition:transform .25s cubic-bezier(.3,1.6,.5,1)}
.kdet .go:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;border-radius:999px;padding:1px 10px;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;white-space:nowrap}
.pill.lic{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--lic) 18%,transparent);color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--lic) 75%,var(--ink))}
.pill.gai{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--gai) 18%,transparent);color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--gai) 75%,var(--ink))}

/* ---------- search bar ---------- */
.bar{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:5;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 90%,transparent);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
  padding-block:10px;margin-inline:calc(-1 * max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px)));padding-inline:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));border-bottom:3px dashed var(--line)}
.bar-in{max-width:1040px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.search{flex:1 1 240px;min-width:0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--card);border:3px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:4px 14px 4px 6px}
.search:focus-within{border-color:var(--blue)}
.search .ci{width:28px;height:28px}
.search input{border:0;outline:0;background:transparent;flex:1;min-width:0;font-size:15px;font-weight:500}
.seg{display:inline-flex;background:var(--card);border:3px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:2px}
.seg button{border:0;background:transparent;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 12px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--muted)}
.seg button.on{background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg)}
.chip{border:3px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);border-radius:999px;padding:2px 12px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;flex:0 0 auto;transition:transform .25s cubic-bezier(.3,1.6,.5,1)}
.chip:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.chip .dot{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%}
.chip .ci{width:20px;height:20px}
.chip.on{border-color:var(--ink);background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg)}
.sel{border:3px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);border-radius:999px;padding:3px 12px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;max-width:100%}
.scroller{display:flex;gap:6px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;padding:2px 0}
.scroller::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.status{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.status b{color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:400;font-size:18px}
.clear{border:0;background:none;color:var(--pink);font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;padding:0;font-size:13px;text-decoration:underline}

/* ---------- cards (2列) ---------- */
#list{margin-top:14px}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}
.whead{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:14px 0 0;scroll-margin-top:160px}
.whead .blob{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:12px 16px 12px 16px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:var(--font-display);color:#2E2B4F;font-size:14px}
.whead h3{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:400;font-size:21px}
.whead span{color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;font-size:13px}
.card{position:relative;background:var(--card);border:3px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;padding:12px 14px 10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;min-width:0;cursor:pointer;
  transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.3,1.6,.5,1),box-shadow .3s,border-color .3s;content-visibility:auto;contain-intrinsic-size:auto 190px}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--cc) 60%,var(--line));box-shadow:0 10px 20px color-mix(in srgb,var(--cc) 16%,transparent)}
.card.fuwa{transform:translateY(-6px) scale(1.02);border-color:var(--cc)}
.ct{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-width:0}
.ct .ci{width:32px;height:32px}
.ct .cat{font-weight:700;font-size:12px;color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--cc) 70%,var(--ink));min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.ct .pill{margin-left:auto}
.card h4{font-size:16px;line-height:1.45;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.mini{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px 10px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700}
.mini span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:3px}
.mini .ci{width:18px;height:18px}
.addr{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);display:flex;gap:3px;align-items:flex-start;line-height:1.5}
.addr .ci{width:18px;height:18px;margin-top:1px}
.cf{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:auto;padding-top:6px;border-top:2px dotted var(--line)}
.hpb,.mapb{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 12px 3px 4px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;border:0;line-height:1.6}
.hpb{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--cc) 16%,var(--card));color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--cc) 70%,var(--ink))}
.hpb.srch{background:var(--soft);color:var(--muted)}
.mapb{background:var(--soft);color:var(--muted)}
.hpb .ci,.mapb .ci{width:22px;height:22px}
.more{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;justify-content:center;padding:14px}
.more button{border:0;cursor:pointer;background:var(--card);border:3px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 20px;font-weight:700}
.empty{text-align:center;padding:40px 16px;color:var(--muted)}
.empty img{width:90px;display:block;margin:0 auto 8px}
.empty b{display:block;font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:400;font-size:20px;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:4px}
@media (max-width:560px){
  .grid{gap:8px}
  .card{padding:10px 10px 8px;border-radius:18px;gap:4px}
  .ct .ci{width:26px;height:26px}
  .ct .pill{display:none}
  .card h4{font-size:14px}
  .mini,.addr{font-size:11.5px}
  .addr{display:none}
  .cf{flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
  .hpb,.mapb{font-size:12px;padding:2px 8px 2px 3px}
}

/* ---------- popover (ふわっとプレビュー) ---------- */
#pop{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:60;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);place-items:center;padding:16px}
#pop .bd{position:absolute;inset:0;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 40%,transparent);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);opacity:0;transition:opacity .35s}
#pop.on .bd{opacity:1}
.pp{position:relative;min-width:0;width:min(560px,calc(100vw - 32px));max-height:100%;overflow:auto;background:var(--glass);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(1.4);backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(1.4);
  border:2px solid var(--glass-line);border-radius:28px;padding:16px;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(46,43,79,.28);opacity:0;transform:translate(var(--fx,0),var(--fy,40px)) scale(.6);transition:opacity .4s,transform .5s cubic-bezier(.25,1.3,.4,1)}
#pop.on .pp{opacity:1;transform:none}
.pp .x{position:absolute;top:10px;right:10px;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:var(--card);cursor:pointer;font-size:18px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(46,43,79,.15);z-index:2}
.pp .ph{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding-right:40px}
.pp .ph .ci{width:52px;height:52px}
.pp .ph .k{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--cc) 70%,var(--ink))}
.pp .ph h3{font-size:19px;line-height:1.4}
.browser{margin-top:12px;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;border:2px solid var(--glass-line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(46,43,79,.16);animation:float 4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes float{50%{transform:translateY(-4px)}}
.browser .bbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:6px 10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.7)}
.browser .bbar i{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;display:block}
.browser .bbar .url{flex:1;min-width:0;margin-left:6px;background:rgba(46,43,79,.06);border-radius:999px;padding:1px 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.screen{position:relative;height:var(--sh,280px);overflow:hidden;display:block;text-decoration:none;color:inherit}
.screen iframe{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;border:0;transform-origin:0 0;pointer-events:none;background:#fff;opacity:0;transition:opacity .6s}
.screen.ok iframe{opacity:.94}

.screen:hover .tapgo{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-3px)}

  <section id="sos-sec">
    <div class="sec-head"><span class="ico" data-icon="doctor"></span><div class="h"><h2><span class="nb">夜中や休日に</span><span class="nb">「どうしよう…」と思ったら</span></h2><p>受診すべきか迷ったら、まず電話で相談できます。番号をタップすると電話がかかります</p></div></div>

$("#sprite").innerHTML=Object.entries(ICONS).map(([k,v])=>`<symbol id="i-${k}" viewBox="0 0 64 64">${v}</symbol>`).join("");
const ic=(k,cls="ci")=>`<svg class="${cls}" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-${k}"/></svg>`;
document.querySelectorAll("[data-icon]").forEach(e=>{e.outerHTML=`<svg class="${e.className}" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-${e.dataset.icon}"/></svg>`});
const reduce=matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

/* logo */
const C1=["#E5484D","#E5484D","#E5484D"],C2=["#D93A40","#E5484D","#D93A40","#E5484D","#D93A40","#E5484D","#D93A40"];
$("#bigt").innerHTML=`<span class="row r1">${[..."小児科"].map((c,i)=>`<i style="--cc:${C1[i]};--d:${i}">${c}</i>`).join("")}</span><span class="row r2">${[..."急患電話マップ"].map((c,i)=>`<i style="--cc:${C2[i]};--d:${i+3}">${c}</i>`).join("")}</span>`;

$("#nAll").textContent=CLINICS.length;

/* tap → ふわっと説明（共通） */
function infoChips(box,det,items){
  let open=null;
  $(box).innerHTML=items.map((it,i)=>`<button class="kchip" data-i="${i}" style="--cc:${it.c}" aria-expanded="false">${ic(it.ic)}${it.l}</button>`).join("");
  $(box).onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest(".kchip");if(!b)return;const i=+b.dataset.i;const it=items[i];
    $(box).querySelectorAll(".kchip").forEach(x=>{const on=x===b&&open!==i;x.classList.toggle("on",on);x.setAttribute("aria-expanded",on)});
    if(open===i){open=null;$(det).innerHTML="";return}open=i;
    const sec=$(box).getBoundingClientRect(),br=b.getBoundingClientRect();
    $(det).innerHTML=`<div class="kdet" style="--cc:${it.c};--ax:${Math.max(18,Math.min(br.left-sec.left+br.width/2-9,sec.width-40))}px">${ic(it.ic,"bigi")}<h3>${it.h||it.l}</h3><div class="meta">${(it.meta||[]).map(m=>`<span>${m}</span>`).join("")}</div><p>${it.d}</p></div>`};
}

const ER=[
 {n:"大宮休日夜間急患センター",a:"北区宮原町1-851（さいたま北部医療センター内）",t:"048-667-8180",h:[["n","小児科（夜間）","19:00〜翌6:00"],["","内科","土曜夜 19:00〜21:30／休日 9:00〜11:30・13:00〜16:30・19:00〜21:30"]]},
 {n:"浦和休日急患診療所",a:"浦和区常盤6-4-18（浦和区保健センター2階）",t:"048-833-0119",h:[["n","小児科（夜間）","19:30〜22:00（診療日は市のページで確認）"],["","内科","土曜夜 19:00〜21:30／休日 9:00〜11:30・13:00〜16:30・19:00〜21:30"]]},
 {n:"与野休日急患診療所",a:"中央区本町西2-9-30",t:"048-711-6067",h:[["","内科","土曜夜 18:45〜21:15／休日 8:45〜11:45・13:00〜15:00・18:45〜21:15"],["n","小児科","時間は市のページで確認してください"]]},
 {n:"岩槻休日夜間急患診療所",a:"岩槻区府内1-8-1（府内別館2階）",t:"048-798-2221",h:[["","内科","19:00〜21:30"],["n","小児科","時間は市のページで確認してください"]],note:"熱などの症状があるときは、受診の前に電話で相談してください。"}
];
const mapURL=(n,a)=>"https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query="+encodeURIComponent("さいたま市"+a.replace(/^さいたま市/,"").split("（")[0]+" "+n);
$("#er").innerHTML=ER.map(e=>`<div class="er"><h3>${ic("hospital")}${e.n}</h3><div class="addr">${ic("pin")}<span>${e.a}</span></div>
  <dl class="hr">${e.h.map(([c,l,v])=>`<dt class="${c}">${l}</dt><dd>${v}</dd>`).join("")}</dl>${e.note?`<p class="ref" style="--rc:#FF9A3D;margin:0">${e.note}</p>`:""}
  <div class="cf"><a class="hpb" style="--cc:#FF6FA5" href="tel:${e.t.replace(/-/g,"")}">${ic("phone")}${e.t}</a><a class="mapb" href="${mapURL(e.n,e.a)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${ic("map")}地図 ↗</a></div></div>`).join("");

/* 小児科さがし */
const WARDS=[["西","nishi"],["北","kita"],["大宮","omiya"],["見沼","minuma"],["中央","chuo"],["桜","sakura"],["浦和","urawa"],["南","minami"],["緑","midori"],["岩槻","iwatsuki"]];
const wcol=w=>`var(--w-${WARDS.find(x=>x[0]===w)[1]})`;
CLINICS.forEach((c,i)=>{c.id=i;c.ww=c.w.replace(/区$/,"");c._s=(c.n+" "+c.a+" "+c.w).normalize("NFKC").toLowerCase()});
const TYPES={"小児科クリニック":{ic:"bear",c:"#FF6FA5",lab:"こども専門"},"内科など＋小児科":{ic:"family",c:"#2ECC85",lab:"家族で行ける"},"病院・専門施設":{ic:"hospital",c:"#3DB2F2",lab:"病院・施設"}};
const CONDS=[["night","夜19時以降も","moon","#5B6FD6"],["sat","土曜も診療","star","#9C7BFF"],["sun","日曜・祝日も","sun","#FF9A3D"],["k","乳幼児健診","baby","#FFB020"],["v","予防接種","shot","#2ECC85"],["ped","小児科クリニックだけ","bear","#FF6FA5"]];
const REFS={must:["紹介状が必要","#E5484D"],fee:["紹介状があると安心","#FF9A3D"],call:["事前に予約・相談","#3DB2F2"]};
const S={q:"",wards:new Set(),f:new Set()};
$("#wardChips").innerHTML=`<button class="chip" data-w="">全区</button>`+WARDS.map(([w])=>`<button class="chip" data-w="${w}"><span class="dot" style="background:${wcol(w)}"></span>${w}区</button>`).join("");
$("#condChips").innerHTML=CONDS.map(([k,l,i])=>`<button class="chip" data-k="${k}">${ic(i)}${l}</button>`).join("");
$("#wardChips").onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest("button");if(!b)return;const w=b.dataset.w;if(!w)S.wards.clear();else S.wards.has(w)?S.wards.delete(w):S.wards.add(w);render()};
$("#condChips").onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest("button");if(!b)return;const k=b.dataset.k;S.f.has(k)?S.f.delete(k):S.f.add(k);render()};
let qt;$("#q").oninput=e=>{clearTimeout(qt);qt=setTimeout(()=>{S.q=e.target.value.trim();render()},140)};
$("#clear").onclick=()=>{S.q="";S.wards.clear();S.f.clear();$("#q").value="";render()};
function card(c){
  const T=TYPES[c.t]||TYPES["内科など＋小児科"];const r=REFS[c.ref];
  const tags=CONDS.filter(([k])=>k!=="ped"&&c[k]).map(([k,l,i,col])=>`<span class="tg" style="--tc:${col}">${l.replace("も診療","").replace("も","")}</span>`).join("");
  const hrs=[["night","moon"],["sat","star"],["sun","sun"]].filter(([k])=>c.h&&c.h[k]).map(([k,i])=>`<span>${ic(i)}${esc(c.h[k])}</span>`).join("");
  const btn=c.lk==="official"?"公式サイト":"診療時間を見る";
  return `<article class="card" style="--cc:${T.c};cursor:default">
    <div class="ct">${ic(T.ic)}<span class="cat">${T.lab}・${c.w}</span></div>
    <h4>${esc(c.n)}</h4>
    ${tags?`<div class="tags2">${tags}</div>`:""}
    ${hrs?`<div class="hrs">${hrs}</div>`:""}
    ${r?`<div class="ref" style="--rc:${r[1]}">${r[0]}${c.refn?`：${esc(c.refn)}`:""}</div>`:""}
    <div class="addr">${ic("pin")}<span>${esc(c.a.replace(/^さいたま市/,""))}</span></div>
    <div class="cf">${c.p?`<a class="hpb" href="tel:${c.p.replace(/[^\d]/g,"")}">${ic("phone")}電話</a>`:""}${c.l?`<a class="hpb srch" href="${esc(c.l)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${ic("clock")}${btn} ↗</a>`:""}<a class="mapb" href="${mapURL(c.n,c.a)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${ic("map")}地図 ↗</a></div>
  </article>`;
}
const EMB=(()=>{try{return !!window.frameElement}catch(e){return true}})();
const PER=40;let page=1,ROWS=[];
function draw(reset){
  const list=$("#list");
  if(!ROWS.length){list.innerHTML=`<div class="empty"><img src="${document.querySelector(".monkey img").src}" alt=""><b>見つかりませんでした</b>しぼりこみを減らすか、別のことばでさがしてみてね。</div>`;return}
  const end=Math.min(ROWS.length,page*PER);let h="",lastW=reset?null:(list.dataset.lastw||null);const start=reset?0:(page-1)*PER;
  if(!reset){const m=list.querySelector(".more");m&&m.remove()}
  for(let i=start;i<end;i++){const r=ROWS[i];
    if(r.ww!==lastW){lastW=r.ww;const n=ROWS.filter(x=>x.ww===r.ww).length;h+=`<div class="whead"><span class="blob" style="background:${wcol(r.ww)}">${r.ww[0]}</span><h3>${r.w}</h3><span class="num">${n}件</span></div>`}
    h+=card(r)}
  if(end<ROWS.length)h+=`<div class="more"><button>もっと見る（あと ${ROWS.length-end} 件）</button></div>`;
  if(reset)list.innerHTML=`<div class="grid">${h}</div>`;else list.querySelector(".grid").insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend",h);
  list.dataset.lastw=lastW||"";
  const m=list.querySelector(".more");if(m&&!EMB&&"IntersectionObserver" in window){const io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>{if(es[0].isIntersecting){io.disconnect();page++;draw(false)}},{rootMargin:"600px"});io.observe(m)}
}
$("#list").addEventListener("click",e=>{if(e.target.closest(".more button")){page++;draw(false)}});
const WO=Object.fromEntries(WARDS.map(([w],i)=>[w,i]));const TO={"小児科クリニック":0,"内科など＋小児科":1,"病院・専門施設":2};
function render(){
  const toks=S.q.normalize("NFKC").toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  ROWS=CLINICS.filter(c=>(!S.wards.size||S.wards.has(c.ww))&&[...S.f].every(k=>k==="ped"?c.t==="小児科クリニック":c[k])&&toks.every(t=>c._s.includes(t)))
    .sort((a,b)=>WO[a.ww]-WO[b.ww]||TO[a.t]-TO[b.t]||(b.k-a.k)||a.n.localeCompare(b.n,"ja"));
  document.querySelectorAll("#wardChips .chip").forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle("on",b.dataset.w?S.wards.has(b.dataset.w):S.wards.size===0));
  document.querySelectorAll("#condChips .chip").forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle("on",S.f.has(b.dataset.k)));
  $("#cnt").textContent=ROWS.length;$("#clear").hidden=!(S.q||S.wards.size||S.f.size);
  page=1;draw(true);
}
render();
</script>

<style>
.backbtn{position:fixed;top:calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px));right:max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));z-index:50;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.94);color:#2E2B4F;border:2px solid #E2E6F3;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 14px 4px 8px;font:700 13px/1.5 "Zen Maru Gothic","Hiragino Maru Gothic ProN",system-ui,sans-serif;
  box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(46,43,79,.14);cursor:pointer;transition:transform .25s cubic-bezier(.3,1.6,.5,1),box-shadow .2s;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px);backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
.backbtn svg{width:20px;height:20px;flex:0 0 auto}
.backbtn:hover,.backbtn:focus-visible{transform:translateY(-2px) scale(1.06);box-shadow:0 6px 14px rgba(46,43,79,.18)}
.backbtn:active{transform:scale(.94)}
.backbtn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #3DB2F2;outline-offset:2px}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .backbtn{background:rgba(38,39,74,.94);color:#F4F2FF;border-color:#3A3B62}}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .backbtn{background:rgba(38,39,74,.94);color:#F4F2FF;border-color:#3A3B62}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.backbtn{transition:none}}
</style>
<button type="button" class="backbtn" id="backbtn" aria-label="前のページにもどる"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="11" fill="#FF6FA5"/><path d="M13.5 7.5 9 12l4.5 4.5" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2.6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>もどる</button>
<script>
(function(){var b=document.getElementById("backbtn");if(!b)return;
b.addEventListener("click",function(){
  var before=location.href,y=window.scrollY;
  try{if(history.length>1){history.back();}}catch(e){}
  setTimeout(function(){if(location.href===before&&window.scrollY===y){window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:"smooth"});}},350);
});})();
</script>

<style>.bar{top:calc(52px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px))!important}@media (max-width:600px){.bar{top:auto!important}}</style>
